caption: The video captures a fireworks burst expanding against a dark night sky. A brilliant white core sits near the center, sending fine radial streaks outward while fainter tendrils arc beyond them. The inner streaks glow deep red in the early portion, then warm into orange and gold as the field of light widens. A green halo blooms around the bright core, intensifying into a vivid ring before fading back into the dominant gold. The whole spherical burst keeps growing in diameter, its streaks lengthening steadily from the center. As the gold trails stretch, tiny violet points ignite at their outer tips, tracing a large luminous outline. The core itself softens from saturated white into a pale yellow-white cloud, while the outer tendrils thin and fade. The expansion and color shifts continue without resolving.
